<description>
Fixes #34414.

### Why

The Guix build scripts set `-fdebug-prefix-map=${DISTSRC}/src=.`. Generated sources (for example the capnp proxies) are in the build tree, outside `${DISTSRC}/src`, so their debug info kept the absolute `/distsrc-base/distsrc-<commit>-<host>/build/...` path. Sources from `src/` were relative. With two kinds of paths, it is hard to set up source path mapping in a debugger.

This maps `${DISTSRC}` instead, in `build_linux.sh`, `build_linux_gui.sh`, `build_win.sh` and `build_win_gui.sh`. The macOS scripts do not set `-fdebug-prefix-map`, so this PR does not change them.

### What changes in the debug paths

All source paths are now relative to the repository root:

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Source in `src/` | `./netaddress.cpp` | `./src/netaddress.cpp` |
| Generated source | `/distsrc-base/distsrc-<commit>-<host>/build/src/ipc/capnp/init.capnp.proxy-client.c++` | `./build/src/ipc/capnp/init.capnp.proxy-client.c++` |

To find the sources in gdb, use the repository root as the source directory (`directory /path/to/bitcoin`) instead of `src/`.

### How I checked

- Guix build of this change on an x86_64 build machine, for the six Linux and Windows hosts.
- `readelf --debug-dump=info`, `--debug-dump=rawline` and `--debug-dump=str` of `libexec/bitcoin-node.dbg` (x86_64-linux-gnu): no `distsrc` string. Sources show as `./src/...`, generated capnp files as `./build/src/...`.
- `bitcoind.exe.dbg` from the Windows debug zip: no `distsrc` string.
- The only absolute paths left come from the Guix toolchain (glibc, libgcc). This change does not affect them.

I will post the Guix hashes for this commit in a comment. I do not have an aarch64 build machine at the moment, so a build from someone with one is welcome.
</description>
